generator.kind: synthetic-deterministic, in memory, in test code only (no files, recordings, clocks or tasks inside the map code)
generator.seedDerivation: first 8 bytes, big-endian, of SHA-256("ww-m2-fixture|v1|M2-TIMEMAP-001|<split>|<index>"); SplitMix64(seed:) drives SyntheticTimeMapGenerator.timeline until the stratum accepts it (rejection sampling, at most maximumDraws), then the same stream drives RoundTripPropertyTests.probe for every occurrence. Disjoint from the pre-freeze regression seeds 0x57573031355f544d and 0x57573031355f4744 (checked by seedsAreStableAndSplitSeparated).

recipe.case: stratum = index mod 7; one SyntheticTimeMapGenerator timeline (1-3 groups of epochs, affine segments, occurrences and spans) per case

strataDetail.multi-segment: some mapped epoch has >= 2 affine segments
strataDetail.gap: some occurrence has a known gap between consecutive spans
strataDetail.unsupported: some span lies on an unsupported epoch
strataDetail.edge-nominal-rate: some occurrence's nominal rate is 1, 7, 44099 or 2^20 Hz

truth: The oracle evaluated in exact rational arithmetic from the generating parameters (M2-C3: u = n/F + e, t = a*u + b; inverse n = F*((t - b)/a - e)), with gaps, unsupported epochs and coverage taken from the generated spans; never from the compiled map under test.
measurement: RoundTripPropertyTests.probe per occurrence. Forward: frames -1, 0, end-1, end, Int64.min/max, every span edge and its neighbours, 3 seeded interior frames per span, the frames either side of every segment knot, a seeded frame in every gap; each must match the oracle state (aligned instant/epoch/provenance, gap with a bracketing boundary, unsupported, outside), aligned times strictly increase, and every aligned frame must round-trip exactly (frame -> aligned -> same frame). Inverse: hull ends, grid instants at a seeded rate in {8000, 44100, 48000, 96000, 192000, F} (ends plus 8 seeded), knot images, 2 seeded rationals per span, points just outside coverage and inside every gap; each must match the oracle state, and a returned source must have exactFrame equal to the oracle, frame = round-half-up(exact), |frame - exact| <= 1/2, and aligned -> nearest frame -> aligned within half a frame of the steepest local slope. Quantisation |frame - exact| is recorded per inverse source; p95 is nearest-rank (value at rank ceil(0.95 n)).

failureCategories.round-trip: frame or inverse round-trip mismatch or > 0.5 source frame
failureCategories.gap-non-invertibility: a gap answered as anything but a gap (or an unbracketed boundary), forward or inverse
failureCategories.unsupported-gap-agreement: unsupported answered as anything else, forward or inverse
failureCategories.oracle-agreement: any other state mismatch, a throw, non-monotonic aligned times, a refused generated timeline, or a stratum not met in maximumDraws

countJustification: Zero failures in n independent cases bounds the per-case failure rate below 3/n at 95% confidence (rule of three). Calibration 700 cases (100 per stratum): about 0.43% overall, 3% per stratum. Holdout 2100 cases (300 per stratum): about 0.14% overall, 1% per stratum. Each case carries about 113 inverse round trips and 75 exact frame round trips (calibration: 78,913 and 52,887), so the holdout's round-trip gate rests on roughly 240,000 inverse probes (rule-of-three bound about 1.3e-5 per probe). A case takes well under a millisecond in parallel; the holdout runs in about a second.

calibration.enable: WW_TIMEMAP_CALIBRATION=1 swift test --filter TimeMapCalibrationTests/calibrationSplitMeetsEveryGate (serialized pass in scripts/test.sh)

gate.verbatim: round trip ≤0.5 source frame (report nearest-rank p95 and the max), gap non-invertibility, and unsupported/gap agreement between forward and inverse

gates.limit: max |frame - exact| <= 0.5 source frame and 0 round-trip failures; nearest-rank p95 and max reported
0 failures; forward and inverse gap probes both present
0 failures; forward and inverse gap and unsupported probes all present
every one of the 7 strata present

gateRule: A gate with no evidence fails; it never passes vacuously (TimeMapGateEvaluation).

preFreezeExecutions.what: Calibration (700 cases): every gate PASS on the first run; run twice more in separate processes with byte-identical records.
RoundTripPropertyTests now records a failure category per failure (no probe, seed or count changed); its 1500-timeline regression run still reports N=146170, max 0.5, p95 0.46635, unchanged.

Compute budget (user-directed): the split now measures at most TimeMapFixture.maxConcurrency cases at once (default 4; WW_M2_FREEZE_MAX_CONCURRENCY may lower it, clamped to 1...4; splitConcurrencyIsCappedAtFour) instead of all cases at once. Calibration rerun with the cap: every gate PASS, records byte-identical to calibration.jsonl. No recipe, truth, seed, count, probe or gate changed.
